entities.title: UTV-first examples
entities.summary: How to do each task of docs/example-tests.md with UTV, one module per UTV class or function, compared with Python's standard library.
entities.purpose: Holds the UTV-first example suite: one test_<class>.py per UTV class (test_parse.py for utv.parse, test_interop.py for from_native / to_native, test_validate.py and test_gregorian.py for the JSON layer) and one TestCase per function. Where UTV and datetime, zoneinfo, calendar or json agree, a test computes its expected value with the standard library; where they differ, it is a literal and the docstring says what the standard library does.
boundaries: Tests between # BEGIN <task-id> and # END <task-id> are copied verbatim into docs/side-by-side.md by tools/side_by_side.py, which reads test_*.py here.
UTV's zone operations use ../fixtures.py (demo_zone_rules); the standard library's side reads this machine's tz database.
